rationale: The explicit setZoomFactor/setZoomLevel behavior is a webcontents/webframe concern; persisted session state and window loading are plausible secondary labels. The body supplies a complete main.js with imports, app readiness, BrowserWindow construction, loadFile and zoom hooks, plus the complete index.html and restart/persistence steps. Code fences and a package.json are not necessary to run those supplied files with Electron. This is sufficient runnable inline code. The retrieved layout, drag crash and accent-color reset reports do not describe zoom persistence overriding a reset. The reporter hypothesizes Chromium persistence but says Chrome is unaffected; a Chromium word alone does not establish an upstream issue.
